newsitem.title: BOSNIA: NATO launches arrest operation - Bosnia govt source.
newsitem.headline: NATO launches arrest operation - Bosnia govt source.

text.p: NATO-led peacekeeping troops launched an operation to arrest an indicted war criminal on Thursday in Bosnian Serb-controlled territory, a Bosnian government source said.
A NATO officer, who asked not to be named, said he could not confirm or deny the report. "There is an ongoing operation. I cannot comment further," he told Reuters in Sarajevo.
The Bosnian government source said that an operation had been launched to capture an indicted war criminal but it was not necessarily aimed at former Bosnian Serb president Radovan Karadzic.
"It began early this morning but we don't know whether it was successful or not," said the source.
The report coincides with a power struggle in Bosnian Serb territory between Karadzic's allies and Bosnian Serb president Biljana Plavsic.
